parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma is offering 1 Sheep for 1 Brick. I have 1 Brick (from the recent 10 roll) and 1 Sheep is useful for development cards or future settlements. More importantly, Gemma is wary of my lead, and Claude is actively trying to turn her against me. Accepting this trade is a low-cost way to maintain my 'helpful' image with Gemma and prove that I'm willing to trade fairly, contrary to Claude's narrative. Since Brick is scarce and I'm the only one producing it, this gesture carries significant political weight without giving her too much power (she only has 2 VP).
parsed.note_to_self: Accepted Gemma's sheep for my brick. This improves our relationship and counters Claude's 'runaway leader' rhetoric, though I've given up my only brick for now.
parsed.say_outloud: בשמחה, ג'מה. הטיט הזה באמת נדיר עכשיו, אבל חשוב לי שנוכל להתקדם למרות הדיבורים של קלוד. מקווה שהכבשה תעזור לי להגיע לעיר בקרוב.
